mechanics.claim: Only the first pellet to hit a target applies on-hit effects and lifesteal is applied by pellets in general.
mechanics.quote: Only the first {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} to hit each enemy applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: The first pellet deals the highest (basic) damage while additional pellets deal reduced (default) damage.
mechanics.quote: Deals the highest damage out of all other pellets.

mechanics.claim: Pellets deal reduced damage to structures.
Graves cannot attack while all shells are expended and reloading.
mechanics.quote: '''Graves''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time if he has expended all {{as|shells|buzzword3}}.

mechanics.claim: Reload is cancelled if Graves reloads a shell via Quickdraw or expends a leftover shell.
mechanics.quote: is cancelled if '''Graves''' reloads a {{as|shell|buzzword3}} with ''{{ai|Quickdraw|Graves}}'' or expends a leftover {{as|shell|buzzword3}}

mechanics.claim: Basic attack resets other than Quickdraw do not affect Graves' basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|basic attack reset|Basic attack resets}} other than {{ai|Quickdraw|Graves}} do not affect '''Graves'''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Non-champion enemies hit by more than one pellet are knocked back.
mechanics.quote: Non-champion units hit by more than one {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}, though not through terrain.
